title: Restore NETStandard 2.1 reference fixtures without an installed targeting pack
outcome: A .NET10-only Linux host can prepare Phoenix's semantic compatibility tests using automatically restored exact reference assets instead of requiring a machine-installed NETStandard2.1 targeting pack.
acceptance: On Linux with .NET SDK10 only and no installed NETStandard.Library.Ref2.1 pack, prerequisite preparation and existing netstandard2.1 semantic/multi-TFM tests pass using normal project-cache restore, preserving exact target references and behavioral assertions.
